description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash K1 decode steps on a TP4 group (DSV41MonoRunner widths 1, 2, 4 and 8: the AgentX concurrency points 1, 2, 4 and 8 sessions, one decode row per request in flight). K1's work is its weights (the replicated wqkv_a, the rank's wq_b and the mHC projections, about 21.7 MB a rank) plus a few rows: it does not depend on the context, so the performance cases vary rows over the production range 1..8 at 262,144, the upper bound of the AgentX decode-step bucket that holds the weighted median context (219,840), and use the production-range span exemption (workload_evidence.json). Derived from corpus statistics (semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126, all 98,827 requests) and the TP4 serving configuration; not yet confirmed by a live capture. Short-context and boundary cases (partial windows and top-k lists in the key table) are correctness-only and reuse the four compiled widths.
